values.title: Post-seal relativistic and electromagnetic field comparison
values.statement: The complete PDG, CODATA and APS record supports Dirac/Lorentz physical structure, one invariant vacuum speed, electric/magnetic observable families and the inverse-square Coulomb exponent. It does not measure the Fold 3/5, 4/5 or four-half closure witnesses as universal particle coordinates.
